Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Brinen Joro: 39-year-old man, 175 cm (medium), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: square compact face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; short rounded nose, wide mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: wrapped central section. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: a hand-painted hem mark. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
